immutable_subject: Git commit SHA truncation in Genesis Manifest.
observed_failure: Genesis Manifest and root provenance records accepted or rendered short (7 or 12 character) Git commit hashes as canonical object identities.
canonical_invariant_violated: FULL_GIT_OID_IDENTITY_ENFORCEMENT: Canonical Git object identifiers in genesis and governance authority contracts must be exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
root_cause: Permissive regex in hash validation allowed truncated Git SHAs, and display strings were reused in identity positions.
contributing_causes: DisplayShortSha formatting conflated with canonical OID storage
existing_behavior: Short Git SHAs accepted without error in certain manifest contexts.
required_behavior: validate_git_oid strictly requires ^[0-9a-f]{40}$; short SHAs allowed only with DisplayShortSha non-authoritative type.
implementation_scope: Enforce validate_git_oid in root_identity.py and canonical_context.py
Verify all Git OIDs in GOVERNANCE_GENESIS_MANIFEST.json are 40 hex chars
planned_fix: Implement strict 40-character hex validation for all canonical Git commit and tree OIDs.
planned_negative_control: Attempt to supply a 7-character short SHA to validate_git_oid; verify ValueError is raised.
planned_causal_ablation: Permit 7-character prefix; verify test fails 40-character full identity invariant.
